Class NativeUiGraphics

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.screen.ui.NativeUiGraphics
public final class NativeUiGraphics extends net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor
Extracts native units into the shared Java GUI render state, including deferred tooltips.
